title: tc-status-tracker
description:
A status tracker – a fixed sequence of steps on a line, each cleared, pending, blocked or not reached, with the line
filling as steps clear, the current step marked, a legend, and a step's record on click or Enter.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

description.description: The line under the heading; by default the count cleared, e.g. "4 of 9 gates cleared"

hint.description: Added after the default description, e.g. "click any gate for its evidence record"

statuses.description: Statuses by key, merged over the defaults (cleared, pending, blocked, not-reached)

noun.description: What a step is called: "Gate" shows "GATE 3" over each name; empty hides it

nounPlural.description: The noun's plural, for the count; by default the noun with an "s"

legend.description: Shows the statuses in use beside the heading

selected.description: The step whose record is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

locale.description: The language for dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

status.description: A key of `statuses`: cleared, pending, blocked, not-reached, or your own

date.description: When it reached its status, as epoch ms

note.description: One quiet line under the date

attention.description: Marks the step with a "!"; a string says why

detail.description: Its record, shown when the step is opened

StatusTrackerStatus.description: How a status looks: its name, tone and mark – and whether it counts as done (fills the line, counts as cleared)
